# example_item (Data Source)

Looks up a single item by name. It is an error if no item has that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "example_item" "web_frontend" {
  name = "web-frontend"
}

output "web_frontend_id" {
  value = data.example_item.web_frontend.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The item's summary, null when it has none.
- `id` (String) Identifier the store assigned to the item.
- `tags` (Set of String) The item's labels, null when it has none.
